text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Actually, I have to give a presentation
in class today...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Just thinking about the upcoming announcement
has had me feeling totally down since yesterday~..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I kept worrying about whether I'd do it right or trip over my words... I thought about so much that I couldn't sleep~...

It seemed Hishi Miracle wasn't able to
get much rest.
